description: This is a front-end React component implementing a Tic-Tac-Toe game UI, handling game logic such as move handling, winner calculation, mode switching (PvP, PvC), and AI move simulation.

published: default export of the HomePage component

methods.name: calcWinner

methods.name: chooseAIMove
methods.description: Simple AI logic that chooses the first available cell for its move.
